build_transformer_model: build a tiny transformer model using mk_transformer with custom encoder and decoder embed dimensions
create_sample_batch: create a batch sample dict with src_tokens and prev_output_tokens using mk_sample
test_forward_backward: test the transformer model forward pass and backward pass with a sample batch
test_different_embed_dim: test the transformer model with different encoder and decoder embedding dimensions
run_transformer_test_case: run the TransformerTestCase unit tests to verify forward and backward passes
